problem.description: The problem the pull request solves.

what_it_gives.description: What the change gives users or developers.

reference.description: URL or `owner/repo#number` of the related item.

kind.description: Kind of relation. `duplicate`: Duplicates this change. `competing_solution`: A competing solution to the same problem. `stacked_pr`: A pull request stacked on or under this one. `linked_issue`: An issue linked to this change. `companion_repository`: A matching change in a companion repository.

overlap.description: One line on the overlap with this pull request.

related_work.description: Related pull requests, issues or mechanisms; may be empty.

items.description: A question about the fit of the change at project scale.

question.description: The question, phrased as a question.

topic.description: What the question is about. `layer_or_repository`: Right layer or repository? `size_for_problem`: Oversized for the problem? `duplicate_mechanism`: Duplicates an existing mechanism? `other`: Another fit question.

evidence.description: Lines read that motivate the question.

items.description: A line the agent actually read and cites as evidence.

file.description: Repository-relative path at the head commit.

line.description: 1-based line number at the head commit.

fit_questions.description: Questions about the fit of the change, never verdicts.

description: The pull request at project scale.
